test_ToTensor: test the ToTensor transform converts lists, tuples, numpy arrays, and PIL images to torch tensors
test_AutoBatch: test the AutoBatch transform batches scalar values into tensors across dicts, tuples, and NamedContext
test_Unbatch: test the Unbatch transform reverses AutoBatch batching and round-trips consistently
test_NormalizeRange: test the NormalizeRange transform maps input tensor values from a source range to a target range
test_Map_NamedContext: test the Map transform applies ToTensor across all fields of a NamedContext
